integrity: The proof reduces smoothness to exact principal-matrix algebra and Weil factors to genus-one quotients. Two independently implemented executable checks cover all 728 nonzero coefficient vectors for smoothness and point counts for all 32 smooth vectors over GF(3), GF(9), and GF(27). No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the fixed six-monomial Ciani coefficient family over F3, modulo scalar; not all genus-three curves or all non-split Ciani twists. Sources establish elliptic quotient techniques; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Three Weil-polynomial spectra for smooth Ciani quartics over F3
